News App Documentation¶

Welcome to the News App technical documentation.

The News App is a Django web application that allows readers, journalists and editors to manage and access news articles and newsletters.

The application includes user authentication, role-based permissions, article approval, publisher subscriptions and a REST API.

Project Features¶

  • User registration and authentication.

  • Reader, journalist and editor roles.

  • News article creation and management.

  • Editorial approval system.

  • Publisher and journalist subscriptions.

  • Newsletter creation and management.

  • Email notifications for approved articles.

  • REST API with token authentication.
